spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the main Hawaiian Islands with Kauai northwest and the large island southeast. Bright white cumulus and cirrus clouds fully cover the large island and form a north-south band west of Maui and extensive cover in the northeast. Western and south-central ocean is dark and clear. No distinct gray haze streak separable from ordinary white clouds is visible.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: Kīlauea summit north and south vent erupted minor spatter overnight. Kīlauea summit is at a high level of pressurization. Fountaining, intrusions, or an eruption in a new location within the summit region could occur in the coming days to weeks.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
